content_blocks.text: Overview
heading_path: Updates to the Cyber Essential Scheme
Overview

content_blocks.text: This PPN applies to central government departments, their executive agencies and non-departmental public bodies, and NHS bodies (collectively referred to as ‘in-scope organisations’).
heading_path: Updates to the Cyber Essential Scheme
Overview

content_blocks.text: This PPN sets out government guidance on ensuring effective cyber security controls are in place for certain types of contract considered to be at a higher risk of cyber security threats; or with certain characteristics that would require them to have a greater regard to cyber security concerns.
heading_path: Updates to the Cyber Essential Scheme
Overview

content_blocks.text: In particular, this PPN requires that suppliers bidding for these types of contract must demonstrate prior to the award of the contract that they hold Cyber Essentials or Cyber Essentials Plus certification (or demonstrate that equivalent controls are in place).
heading_path: Updates to the Cyber Essential Scheme
Overview

content_blocks.text: In-scope organisations should note that there may be cases where a higher level of security controls are required, and should specify these requirements accordingly.
heading_path: Updates to the Cyber Essential Scheme
Overview

content_blocks.text: Objective at this commercial stage
heading_path: Updates to the Cyber Essential Scheme
Objective at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: Effective due diligence should be conducted to verify that suppliers hold a valid Cyber Essentials or Cyber Essentials Plus certification (or equivalent) as part of every in-scope procurement.
heading_path: Updates to the Cyber Essential Scheme
Objective at this commercial stage
